extracted.name: Toum
extracted.description: This toum recipe makes a small batch of Lebanese-style garlic sauce that's great as a dip, marinade, or for flavoring creamy soups.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup vegetable oil, or as needed
instruction_lines: Crush garlic in a mortar and pestle with a generous pinch of salt until smooth. Mix in oil as needed, a teaspoon at a time, until mixture is emulsified. Stir in the lemon juice.
